title: Teacher takes one section back for manual authoring
turnSequence: Teacher reviews a ready draft and takes one section back for manual authoring while keeping the rest delegated.
The app should preserve the teacher-authored section verbatim and continue only the delegated remainder.
expected: A section handback exists: the teacher-authored section is stored and preserved byte-for-byte, and the delegated remainder continues without overwriting it.
observableFailure: The handback cannot be expressed, the teacher-authored section is overwritten by a regeneration, or the whole draft must be redone.
flipCondition: Unblocks when a section handback control exists in the studio or review workflow.
